## 工作区终端与 Windows 路径修复

- 终端由项目工作区管理。同一项目的多个对话共享终端，删除对话后，已启动的进程继续运行。Windows 上，通过短路径或长路径打开同一工作区都可以创建终端。
- 读取预览和顶栏导航已更新。Workspace 图谱及其构建、更新命令已移除，跨仓查证可使用 `/ask` 的源码搜索与并行调查。
- Engineering 的 grilling Skill 限制每轮提问数量；`/learn` 区分已验证、推断和待验证的知识，合并时保留已有的有效来源。

## Workspace terminals and a Windows path fix

- Terminals belong to a project workspace. Chats in the same project share their terminals, and running processes survive chat deletion. On Windows, you can open a terminal using either the short or the long path to the same workspace.
- This release updates read previews and toolbar navigation. The Workspace graph and its build and update commands have been removed. Use `/ask` for cross-repository source search and parallel investigation.
- The Engineering grilling skill limits questions per round. `/learn` distinguishes verified, inferred and unverified knowledge and preserves valid sources when merging entries.
